headline: Sensex and Nifty open higher as brokerages turn bullish on Dixon Tech and insurance sectors following market holiday

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: IRDAI's reform recalibration is boosting the outlook for the insurance sector, drawing brokerage support.
JPMorgan maintains Dixon Tech as a top pick in the EMS space despite memory price concerns.
Markets are reopening and reacting to global cues after the Guru Nanak Jayanti holiday.
Record FII buying has driven Sensex and Nifty to 9-month highs during November.
whatHappening: Sensex and Nifty opened higher today despite mixed global market signals.
Indian pension funds are pivoting toward bonds as their equity exposure nears regulatory caps.
Gold prices have fallen over 2% as bets on interest rate hikes increase globally.
Investors have gained significant wealth in November, despite recent profit-taking in financial stocks.
summary: Indian markets opened higher today following a holiday, supported by positive brokerage outlooks on Dixon Tech and the insurance sector. While recent sessions saw profit-taking in financials, record FII buying has driven indices to 9-month highs this month. Investors are also monitoring a shift in pension fund allocations toward bonds and declining global gold prices.
